# Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We want `coze2dify` to be a respectful, practical, and technically rigorous
community. Contributors, maintainers, and users are expected to participate in
ways that keep discussion focused, constructive, and safe for everyone.

## Expected Behavior

- Be respectful in technical disagreement.
- Assume good intent, but challenge ideas with evidence.
- Keep feedback specific, actionable, and relevant to the repository.
- Share enough context to reproduce issues, especially for migration bugs.
- Respect privacy and avoid posting secrets, tokens, or private data.

## Unacceptable Behavior

- Harassment, personal attacks, intimidation, or discrimination.
- Trolling, baiting, or repeatedly derailing technical discussions.
- Publishing private information, credentials, or security-sensitive details.
- Abusive language or dismissive behavior toward contributors or users.
- Repeatedly ignoring repository guidelines after maintainer feedback.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to:

- GitHub issues, pull requests, discussions, and code review comments
- Repository documentation and examples
- Project-related community spaces managed by maintainers

## Enforcement

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, contact the maintainers
through GitHub at [biaoma-ty](https://github.com/biaoma-ty). Include links,
screenshots, or any other context that helps explain what happened.

Maintainers may remove comments, close discussions, reject contributions, or
take any other action needed to protect the community and keep collaboration
productive.

## Attribution

This document was informed by the spirit of the
